candidate_units.form: prescript and multiplied-mercy greeting followed by appeal, occasion, and intruder description
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: sender/addressee and greeting frame move through beloved appeal and changed writing purpose into the causal certain-persons description
candidate_units.preference_basis: The opening supplies the audience/greeting frame and the appeal is incomplete without its causal occasion; v5 begins an explicit reminder and example sequence.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Splitting identity language invites authorship or sibling reconstruction; isolating faith or forewritten language invites canon/doctrine claims; isolating the description can create opponent, ethics, Christology, or discipline policy.

candidate_units.form: remembered judgment exempla, dreamer indictment and Michael counterexample, woe triad, metaphor catalogue, Enochic prophecy, and speech-behavior close
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: reminder formula opens Egypt-angels-cities examples; likewise moves to accusation/counterexample, woe and Cain-Balaam-Korah examples, nature metaphors, prophecy and its grumbling/boasting application
candidate_units.preference_basis: The full warning/evidence movement accumulates examples, counterexample, analogies, citation, and behavioral application; its functional subunits remain alternatives, not isolated authorities.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomization can choose Jude 5's reading, sources or dependence, Enochic/pseudepigraphal canon status, angel/demon systems, Moses tradition, sexual/judgment doctrine, Balaam/Korah policy, opponent identity, or Christology.

candidate_units.form: apostolic-word remembrance, scoffer description, and beloved build-pray-keep-await-mercy-rescue response
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: but-you-beloved remembrance and quoted prediction identify the contrast; a second but-you-beloved turn gives communal formation and mercy/save/snatch instructions
candidate_units.preference_basis: The remembered warning defines the situation to which the coordinated beloved-response chain answers; variant mercy/rescue cases must remain inside that response.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Detaching prediction from response can create opponent chronology or faction claims; atomizing vv20-23 can select textual readings, Spirit/assurance doctrine, rescue, fear, purity, discipline, pastoral, or church policy.

candidate_units.form: ability-to-keep and present doxology with divine titles and temporal acclamation
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: now-to-him opening carries the keep/present clauses into the sole-God acclamation, glory-majesty-power-authority register, temporal sweep, and amen
candidate_units.preference_basis: The recipient and ability clauses require the acclamation and titles for syntactic and doxological completion; the response reaches closure in v23 before the doxology turn.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Splitting v24 from v25 can create isolated assurance, divine-title, Christological, or temporal doctrine; merging backward can convert exhortation into a doctrinal system or erase the formal close.

internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.use: Egypt rescue/judgment, angel/domain, cities, example-triad, and remembered-warning comparison only
internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.guard: Canonical relations do not choose Jude 5's subject reading, establish an angel/sexual/judgment chronology, identify opponents, harmonize traditions, force doctrine, or authorize a seam.

internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.use: Moses-death context, rebuke formula, Michael naming/function, dispute, and authority-speech contrast only
internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.guard: No relation reconstructs a lost source, decides dependence, angel/demon identity or hierarchy, body-of-Moses meaning, reading, Christology, authority policy, doctrine, or boundaries.

internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.use: Cain-Balaam-Korah example triad, self-feeding shepherd, waterless cloud, wave, and fruitlessness metaphor comparison only
internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.guard: The relations do not merge distinct figures, identify opponents or offices, define motive/history/policy, settle metaphor readings, or authorize discipline, doctrine, theology, or a split.

internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.use: Enoch genealogy, holy-ones coming, judgment scene, and prophetic-speech register comparison only
internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.guard: These relations do not decide citation source, literary dependence, canon or pseudepigrapha status, inspiration, chronology, Christology, judgment doctrine, opponent identity, or seams.

internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.use: remembered warning, last-time scoffing, watch/build/pray/keep/mercy response, preservation, presentation, and doxology comparison only
internal_bible_citations_and_allusions_e.guard: Especially 2 Peter cannot decide dependence, direction, common source, authorship, canon, outline, reading, policy, doctrine, theology, or boundaries; no relation universalizes rescue/discipline instructions.

second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.use: holy-ones judgment, watcher transgression/binding, darkness, wandering-star, and Enochic discourse comparison only
second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.misuse_guard: 1 Enoch is boundary evidence here and cannot settle Jude's source/dependence, canon or pseudepigrapha status, inspiration, angel/demon ontology, chronology, reading, Christology, doctrine, theology, or seams.

second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.use: angelic transgression, spirits, binding/judgment, and post-flood tradition comparison only
second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.misuse_guard: Jubilees cannot be conflated with Jude or 1 Enoch, identify beings or opponents, establish source, choose readings, govern demonology/angelology, canon, doctrine, theology, or boundaries.

second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.route: Testament of Moses 10:1-10; extant fragments do not preserve Jude's body-of-Moses dispute
second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.use: Moses-associated eschatological victory/judgment reception and an explicit absence control for the body dispute only
second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.misuse_guard: The absence control forbids claiming this extant text as Jude's direct source; it cannot reconstruct lost wording, decide dependence, body meaning, angel/demon roles, canon status, doctrine, theology, or seams.

second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.route: Philo, Life of Moses 1.263-305; Josephus, Antiquities 4.102-158

second_temple_enochic_angel_moses_balaam.misuse_guard: These retellings cannot define Jude's Balaam phrase, establish dependence, identify opponents or motives, authorize finance/prophecy/discipline policy, or decide canon, doctrine, theology, or boundaries.

greco_roman_invective.misuse_guard: Rhetorical theory cannot reduce Jude to convention, prove composition method or audience, identify targets, authorize abusive speech, establish source/date/authorship, or force literary seams.

greco_roman_invective.use: direct address, vice catalogue, animal/body metaphors, action accumulation, and public blame comparison only
greco_roman_invective.misuse_guard: Roman political invective cannot normalize Jude's accusations, identify social rank/history/factions, license modern polemic, determine policy, dependence, theology, or boundaries.

greco_roman_invective.use: wandering impostor, appetite, boast, gain, and false-teacher characterization comparison only
greco_roman_invective.misuse_guard: Satire cannot identify Jude's opponents, establish Cynic or philosophical setting, turn metaphors into biography, authorize contempt/policy, or decide source, doctrine, theology, or seams.

later_jewish_rabbinic.use: later reception of Korah's dispute and Balaam-associated character contrasts only
later_jewish_rabbinic.misuse_guard: Later rabbinic categories cannot be projected backward as Jude's source, opponent map, moral taxonomy, policy, semantic authority, canon/doctrine/theology, or boundary evidence.

later_jewish_rabbinic.use: later Balaam and Korah reception, motive, speech, punishment, and dispute traditions only
later_jewish_rabbinic.misuse_guard: Later expansions cannot fill Jude's unstated details, identify persons/factions, establish dependence, govern discipline/judgment, select doctrine/theology, or force seams.

later_jewish_rabbinic.use: later Jewish angel/Genesis 6 reception history only
later_jewish_rabbinic.misuse_guard: This substantially later witness cannot be retrojected as Jude's source or setting, settle angel/demon/sexual readings, determine canon/doctrine/theology, or authorize boundaries.

patristic.route: Tertullian, On the Apparel of Women 1.3
patristic.use: early Christian reception of Jude's Enoch citation and canon-pressure argument only
patristic.misuse_guard: Tertullian's argument cannot select Enoch's canon/pseudepigrapha status, prove Jude's source or inspiration theory, decide authorship/Christology/doctrine/theology, or force a seam.

patristic.use: early reception of the Michael/devil/body-of-Moses dispute and spiritual-being interpretation pressure only
patristic.misuse_guard: Origen cannot settle a lost source, dependence, angel/demon ontology, body meaning, reading, canon, Christology, doctrine, theology, or boundaries.

patristic.route: Clement of Alexandria, Adumbrations on Jude (fragmentary Latin transmission)
patristic.use: early reception of Jude's examples, named traditions, moral catalogue, exhortation, and doxology only
patristic.misuse_guard: Fragmentary reception cannot decide authorship, opponents, sources, readings, canon/pseudepigrapha status, angelology, policy, doctrine, theology, or seams.

patristic.route: Bede, Commentary on the Seven Catholic Epistles, commentary on Jude
patristic.use: later patristic reception of examples, invective, mercy/rescue cases, and doxology only
patristic.misuse_guard: Later exposition cannot govern Jude's original semantics or setting, select readings/sources/canon, universalize discipline, or authorize doctrine, theology, or boundaries.

hardest_seams.why: The causal occasion names the target of the reminder, but v5 formally opens the evidence sequence; preserve 1-4/5-16 and retain 4-16.
Likewise applies the remembered triad to the dreamer indictment; keep the large warning and retain 5-7/8-10 without using angel or sexual readings as seam authority.
The Michael contrast closes the knowledge/speech unit and woe opens Cain-Balaam-Korah; both accumulate the same indictment, so prefer 5-16 and retain the subunit route.
The metaphor catalogue reaches darkness and the Enochic prophecy begins about these; citation and application cohere with the indictment and must not be isolated for source/canon claims.
Speech/behavior catalogue closes the indictment and but-you-beloved remembrance opens response; preserve the major 5-16/17-23 turn.
Prediction/description supplies the contrast for the second but-you-beloved response; prefer 17-23 and retain 17-19/20-23.
Mercy/rescue cases complete the response and now-to-him opens doxology; preserve the seam while allowing 17-25 as a larger closing alternative.

premortem: Do not retain one chapter or split every example, metaphor, citation, imperative, title, or verse; preserve four larger movements unless governed review supplies stronger evidence.

Do not detach appeal from occasion, judgment triad from indictment, Michael counterexample from accusation, Cain-Balaam-Korah from metaphor catalogue, Enochic prophecy from application, remembered warning from response, mercy/rescue variants from their chain, or doxology recipient from acclamation.
Do not turn 2 Peter or other internal-Bible relations into dependence, direction, common source, authorship, canon, outline, reading, doctrine, theology, graph, retrieval, or boundary truth.

Do not let Enochic, angel, Moses, Balaam, Greco-Roman invective, later rabbinic, or patristic evidence override Jude or establish source/dependence, canon/pseudepigrapha status, inspiration, authorship, beings, policy, doctrine, theology, or seams.

Do not select Jude 5 or vv22-23 readings, angel/demon systems, body-of-Moses explanation, Enochic status, opponent identity, sexual/judgment/church-discipline policy, Christology, assurance, doctrine, or theology.
Do not use Jude's invective as permission for modern abusive rhetoric, identity assignment, faction labeling, exclusion, discipline, or platform policy.
Keep every route LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus; exact alternatives remain live.
